quotations.old_english: Sce. Marian freólstída ealle weorþie man georne
quotations.english: let all St. Mary's feast-tides be strictly honoured

source_text: freóls-tíd, e; f. A feast-tide; fest&i-long;vum tempus:-- Æt ðissere freólstíde at this feast-tide, Homl. Th. ii. 264, 17. Sce. Marian freólstída ealle weorþie man georne let all St. Mary's feast-tides be strictly honoured, L. Eth. v. 14; Th. i. 308, 13. Freólstídan and fæstentídan at festival-tides and fast-tides, L. C. S. 38; Th. i. 398, 17. DER. heáh-freólstíd.
